articles.title: Iraq bars plane carrying Iran's soccer team from landing in Basra over US sanctions, officials say

articles.title: US charges 3 men with plotting terror attacks, including planned assault on UK airbase
articles.description: U.S. authorities have charged three men with plotting a campaign of nearly 20 attacks targeting Jewish communities in Europe and the U.S., along with a British military base, RAF Fairford. Charges against a dual Iranian-Iraqi national, an Iranian national and an Iraqi national were outlined in a superseding indictment unsealed Tuesday in Manhattan federal court. U.S. Attorney Jamie McDonald in New York said the dual Iranian-Iraqi national, the only suspect in custody, had continued to coordinate with his co-defendants in the days leading up to an attempted September terrorist plot at the British Royal Air Force Base in Fairford, where U.S. bombers were stationed. The arrests prompted the U.S. military to withdraw its bombers to their American home bases.
